cubit.note: Scripture does not define the cubit. The common cubit is taken as about 45.7 cm (18 in); a longer “royal” cubit of about 52.4 cm is also used. Both are estimates.

span.note: Half a common cubit (about 22.9 cm) — an estimate.

handbreadth.note: A sixth of a common cubit (about 7.6 cm) — an estimate.

reed.note: Ezekiel 40:5: “a measuring reed of six cubits long by the cubit and an hand breadth”.

furlong.note: The KJV “furlong” renders the Greek stadion, about 185 m — an estimate.

shekel.note: A shekel is usually estimated at about 11.4 g; weights varied.

talent.note: Exodus 38:25–26 implies 3,000 shekels to the talent (about 34 kg) — an estimate.

items.label: The court
items.phrase: The length of the court shall be an hundred cubits, and the breadth fifty

items.label: A board of the tabernacle
items.phrase: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board

items.label: The tabernacle, south side
items.phrase: twenty boards on the south side

items.label: The tabernacle, west side
items.phrase: westward thou shalt make six boards
items.derivation: 6 boards × 1½ cubits = 9 cubits, plus two corner boards (Exodus 26:23). How the corner boards add to the width is not stated.

items.label: One curtain
items.phrase: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits

items.label: The ark of the testimony
items.phrase: two cubits and a half shall be the length thereof

items.label: The ark
items.phrase: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits

items.label: The house
items.phrase: the length thereof was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof twenty cubits, and the height thereof thirty cubits

items.label: The porch
items.phrase: twenty cubits was the length thereof

items.label: The oracle
items.phrase: twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height thereof

items.label: The molten sea
items.phrase: ten cubits from the one brim to the other

items.label: Goliath’s height
items.phrase: whose height was six cubits and a span

items.label: The coat of mail
items.phrase: the weight of the coat was five thousand shekels of brass

items.label: The spear’s head
items.phrase: his spear’s head weighed six hundred shekels of iron

items.label: The image
items.phrase: whose height was threescore cubits, and the breadth thereof six cubits

items.label: The bedstead
items.phrase: nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man

items.label: The wall
items.phrase: an hundred and forty and four cubits

source: Measurements quoted from the KJV; conversions are estimates
